config.applyCommand.description: Command used to run a change's pending tasks with an agent. Available variables: `${changeId}` (change id) and `${cwd}` (project folder). It is written to the integrated terminal.
config.archiveCommand.description: Command used to archive a completed change. Variables: `${changeId}`, `${cwd}`.
config.autoRunApply.description: When enabled, the 'Run tasks' command is sent with a trailing newline (runs instantly). When disabled, it is only written to the terminal so you can review and run it yourself.
config.proposalCommand.description: Command used to create a new proposal with an agent. Variables: `${description}` (the requirement/change description you type) and `${cwd}` (project folder). It is written to the integrated terminal.
